user.title: Discogs personal access token
user.description: Enter your Discogs personal access token (discogs.com -> Settings -> Developers). Your collection's artist list is matched against the upcoming gigs from Gig Finder.

spotify.title: Spotify playlists
spotify.description: Pick any number of Spotify playlists whose artists should also match against upcoming gigs. Leave empty to use Discogs only.

calendar.title: Secondary calendar
calendar.description: Optional: pick a calendar to cross-reference against. Gigs whose name loosely matches (on the exact same date) a calendar event are treated as already booked and hidden from the results.

error.invalid_token: The token is invalid or the account could not be verified.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Discogs. Try again.

abort.already_configured: Discogs/Spotify Calendar Filter is already configured.

init.title: Discogs/Spotify Calendar Filter options
init.description: Edit the Spotify playlists, the sync target playlist, the secondary calendar and the collection-sync exclusion rules. Releases on the keep-list stay in the playlist even when their genre or style matches an exclusion. Leave the sync playlist empty to use Discogs only.

data.keep_releases: Keep these releases despite excluded genres/styles (comma-separated Discogs titles)

sync_collection.name: Sync Collection
sync_collection.description: Adds the albums in the Discogs collection to the configured (or supplied) Spotify playlist, skipping any album already present.

realign_playlist.name: Re-align Playlist
realign_playlist.description: Makes the target playlist an exact mirror of the Discogs collection: removes tracks whose album is not in the collection and adds any missing album.
